title: QA Specialist — HighLevel Builds (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About Taft Systems



Taft Systems is a US-based HighLevel white-label fulfillment company. We build and support HighLevel accounts for marketing agencies across the country. Our team is fully remote, and we hold our work to a high standard. Every deliverable that leaves this company goes through QA first — no exceptions. That's the role we're hiring for.



What You'll Do



You are the final checkpoint before anything reaches a client. Your job is to catch what the builder missed — broken triggers, wrong naming conventions, untested workflows, logic gaps — and return it with specific, documented notes so it can be fixed. You do not build. You review, test, and document.





Review completed HL builds against the client brief and our internal standards

Check workflow logic, trigger conditions, naming conventions, and integration connections

Return flagged work to the builder with clear, specific notes — not vague feedback

Maintain and update the QA checklist as our standards evolve

Track rework rates and report to the Technical Lead daily

Follow internal SOPs exactly as written — this role requires strict adherence to documented processes





What We're Looking For





Strong HighLevel knowledge — workflows, automations, sub-account settings, pipelines, calendars, triggers

Extreme attention to detail — your entire value is catching what others missed

Clear written English — your feedback notes must be specific and actionable

Ability to follow detailed SOPs to the letter, every time, without shortcuts

Experience in QA, testing, or technical review is a plus

Reliable internet connection required



A note on how we work: We are a systems-driven team. We use documented processes for everything, and we expect every tea
mber to follow those processes exactly. Please use the word Dragonfly in the subject line of your application. If you prefer to figure things out your own way rather than follow a defined procedure, this is not the right role.



Hours



Full-time. First 30 days: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET (with a 30-minute lunch break). After 30 days, there is potential to shift to a schedule based on performance and team needs. All hours are US Eastern Time.



All tea
mbers are required to attend a daily Zoo
eting with camera on. This is a condition of employment.



How to Apply



Read this carefully — applications that don't follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



Record a short Loom video (1–2 minutes) answering these three questions:



How long have you been working in HighLevel, and what do you know how to do in the platform?

Tell us about a time you caught an error in someone else's work. What did you find and what did you do?

What does your workspace and internet setup look like?





Send your Loom link and your resume.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid skills test before any interview.

title: Static Creatives Creator for Meta Ads
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing Shopify direct-to-consumer (DTC) sleep technology brand, and we are looking for a highly capable, sharp, and proactive Static Creatives Creator for Meta Ads 
 & Instagram). This is a role for a conversion-focused graphic designer who understands direct response marketing, consumer psychology, and how to stop the scroll.



You will take complete ownership of our static ad pipeline. We are not looking for a corporate brand designer who only cares about making things look "pretty." We need a visual marketer who knows how to design high-converting ad concepts—such as Us vs. Them charts, feature callouts, social proof/reviews, and press listicles.



If you are someone who waits to be handed a pixel-perfect brief every morning, this is not the role for you. We need a creative engine who can look at our product, study our customer reviews, research competitor ads, and independently pitch and execute winning ad angles.



Core Responsibilities

- End-to-End Visual Ad Design (Figma): Creatively conceptualize and design high-converting static image ads and simple 
 for
 and Instagram.

- Angle & Hook Ideation: Independently research our customer avatar and competitors to develop new direct response angles (e.g., problem/solution, scientific proof, emotional hooks, cost-benefit analysis).

- High-Volume Creative Iteration: Take winning ad concepts and systematically iterate on them. You will swap headlines, test different background colors, try alternative product imagery, and adjust layouts to find the ultimate conversion winner.

- Ad Copy Integration: Write and integrate punchy, high-converting on-image copy, headlines, and text callouts that clearly communicate value propositions within milliseconds.

- Performance-Driven Designing: Review weekly ad performance data with our media buying team to understand why certain designs won or lost, using those insights to guide your next batch of creatives.



Required Qualifications & Skills

- Figma Proficiency is Mandatory: You must use Figma as your primary tool. Your files must be clean, highly organized, and optimized for rapid duplication and variation testing.

- Direct Response (DR) Experience is Mandatory: You deeply understand Meta ad design principles. You know how to design for mobile, what a high-contrast scroll-stopper looks like, and how to establish a clear visual hierarchy.

- Ad Portfolio Required: A proven track record showcasing past Meta/TikTok static image ads that you have designed. We want to see direct response, conversion-focused e-commerce designs, not just standard social media posts.

- Basic Copywriting Skills: Strong command of written English with the ability to write sharp, persuasive on-image text and headlines that appeal to US consumers.

- Proactive & Analytical Mindset: You don't just wait for instructions. You actively spy on competitors via the Meta Ad Library, spot gaps in our creative matrix, and bring fresh ad formats to the table.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable computer capable of handling design software smoothly.



Nice-to-Haves (Not Mandatory)

- Prior experience designing ads for sleep-tech, health/wellness, or premium home goods brands.

- Familiarity with ad intelligence tools like Foreplay, Atria, and/or the Meta Ad Library.



How to Apply:

If you are sharp, highly creative, and ready to scale our Meta ad performance through world-class static creatives, please reply with:

- A link to your design portfolio specifically showcasing your past e-commerce Meta ad creatives (Figma links or web portfolios preferred).

title: Meta Ads Creative Strategist
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing Shopify direct-to-consumer (DTC) sleep technology brand, and we are looking for a highly analytical, sharp, and proactive Creative Strategist for Meta Ads.



To be incredibly clear: This is NOT a graphic design or video editing role. You will not be pushing pixels in Figma or editing timelines in Premiere.



You are the architect of our ad account. Your job is to conduct deep market research, understand consumer psychology, develop high-converting direct response (DR) angles, and write airtight creative briefs for our design and editing teams. You must understand why people buy and know how to structure a scroll-stopping hook and a persuasive script that sells.



If you are someone who waits to be handed a list of ideas to brief, or if you just guess what might look "cool" without looking at the data, this is not the role for you. We need a strategic powerhouse who owns the creative testing roadmap from insight to execution to analysis.



Core Responsibilities

- Deep Avatar & Market Research: Obsessively research our target demographic. You will scour competitor ad libraries, mine customer reviews, read Reddit threads, and analyze TikTok comments to uncover hidden pain points and desires.  

- Angle & Concept Ideation: Develop original, direct response advertising angles. You will translate your research into structured concepts (e.g., problem/solution, Us vs. Them, scientific proof/temperature control comparisons, emotional triggers). 

- Airtight Creative Briefing: Write highly detailed, idiot-proof creative briefs and video scripts for our designers and editors. Your briefs must clearly define the hook, the visual layout, the on-screen text, the pacing, and the core CTA.  

- Creative Performance Analysis: You won't just launch briefs and forget them. title: Owner Operator Dispatch Coordinator
description:
Gomez Haulers (GH Logistics Affiliate) is a growing asset-based trucking operation and owner-operator program focused on keeping freight moving safely, efficiently, and profitably. We support independent owner-operators running under the Gomez Haulers MC through dedicated contract freight, strategic dispatching, compliance oversight, and operational support.



This is not a call center position. This is a real trucking operations role where you will work directly with drivers, dispatchers, and operations leadership to ensure loads move successfully from assignment to delivery while maintaining compliance, documentation accuracy, and strong driver support.



Role Overview

You will serve as the primary operational point of contact for a group of owner-operators operating under the Gomez Haulers network. You will manage freight planning, dispatch operations, driver communication, compliance oversight, documentation, settlements, and operational support while ensuring every driver has the tools and guidance needed to operate successfully.



This role requires someone who thrives in fast-paced transportation environments, communicates effectively with drivers and brokers, stays organized under pressure, and takes ownership of problems before they become operational disruptions.



What You’ll Be Doing



Load Booking

• Book profitable freight and negotiate rates with brokers to maximize revenue and build long-term partnerships.

• Strategically plan and dispatch loads to maximize loaded miles, reduce deadhead, and improve fleet utilization.

• Source freight through load boards and dispatch platforms while identifying opportunities for dedicated lanes and consistent freight.



Dispatch & Load Management

• Assign dedicated routes and scheduled loads based on driver availability, location, and equipment.

• Manage daily route boards and confirm driver assignments, departure times, and delivery schedules.

• Coordinate return loads, backhauls, and spot market opportunities when applicable.

• Monitor active loads in real time through tracking platforms and GPS visibility tools.

• Communicate route changes, delays, weather impacts, and operational updates to drivers promptly.

• Ensure all assigned loads have confirmed driver, trailer, and departure information before dispatch.



Driver Communication & Support

• Serve as the primary point of contact for owner-operators throughout their workday.

• Maintain consistent communication through phone, messaging platforms, and operational systems.

• Conduct daily check-ins with active drivers to confirm schedules, progress, and operational concerns.

• Coordinate with facilities, customers, and internal departments to resolve issues impacting deliveries.

• Escalate a
, breakdowns, service failures, delays, and compliance concerns immediately.



Documentation & Administrative Oversight

• Review and process Bills of Lading (BOLs), Proofs of Delivery (PODs), rate confirmations, and supporting documentation.

• Ensure delivery documents are uploaded accurately and within required deadlines.

• Maintain driver qualification records, insurance documentation, and compliance files.

• Track fuel receipts, toll records, scale tickets, and other required operational paperwork.

• Prepare and submit weekly settlement and operational reports.



Compliance & Safety Monitoring

• Monitor driver Hours of Service (HOS) and ELD activity.

• Identify and address potential compliance violations before they occur.

• Track expiration dates for medical cards, licenses, inspections, drug testing requirements, and qualification files.

• Coordinate annual inspections and required compliance documentation.

• Report safety i
 and compliance concerns to leadership immediately.



Billing & Settlement Support

• Coordinate with billing teams to ensure completed loads are invoiced accurately and on time.

• Verify settlement deductions, advances, fuel charges, and related driver expenses.

• Reconcile completed loads against settlement records and identify discrepancies.

• Assist drivers with settlement questions and escalate complex issues when necessary.



Operational Excellence

• Maintain accurate information across company systems and operational platforms.

• Identify recurring operational issues and recommend process improvements.

• Provide daily and weekly operational updates to management.

• Take ownership of assigned drivers and loads from dispatch through completion.



Who We’re Looking For

• 1+ year of experience in booking loads, trucking dispatch, freight brokerage, logistics coordination, or transportation operations.

• Strong understanding of trucking terminology including BOLs, PODs, ELDs, HOS, DOT, MC numbers, and rate confirmations.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple drivers, loads, and priorities simultaneously.

• Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

• Comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced environment where delays, breakdowns, and operational changes occur daily.

• Self-directed, accountable, and capable of working independently in a remote environment.

• Reliable home office setup with stable internet and backup solutions.

• Ability to work U.S. Central Time business hours consistently.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Samsara, DAT, Truckstop, MONARC, LoadStop, McLeod, Aljex, Turvo, or similar transportation platforms.

• Experience supporting owner-operators or independent contractors.

• Knowledge of dedicated contract freight operations.

• Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire with a US-Based Transportation Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Mon - Fri 8 AM - 5 PM with flexibility for weekend coverage CDT (San Antonio time)

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Camera-on Zoom environment during shifts

• Hubstaff time tracking may be required



What You'll Get

• $6.00/hour. Paid consistently biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Long-term, stable position supporting a growing owner-operator division. (This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.)

• Opportunity to develop dispatch, compliance, and fleet management expertise

• Advancement opportunities as the owner-operator program expands



Growth Path

Top performers may advance into:

• Senior Dispatch Coordinator ($7-$8/hr)

• Dispatch Team Lead ($8-$9/hr)

• Owner-Operator Operations Coordinator ($9-$10/hr)



As the owner-operator fleet grows, additional leadership and operational opportunities will become available for individuals who demonstrate ownership, reliability, and strong operational execution.



Who Thrives Here

• Dispatchers who enjoy solving operational problems in real time.

• Logistics professionals who take ownership instead of waiting for direction.

• Individuals who communicate proactively and build strong driver relationships.

• Tea
mbers who can balance urgency, compliance, customer service, and operational execution simultaneously.

• Operators who want long-term growth within a rapidly expanding trucking organization.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics, and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

title: E-commerce/DTC Video Editor - For Ads (Full Time)
description:
Performance-focused · AI-augmented · Long-term



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets — and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land — who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics





Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Compensation: 900–1,100 USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3–4 finished edits per day





What you'll own





Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok — fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent — every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll — you know the first 1–2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook ? Problem ? Mechanism ? CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools — realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences





Non-negotiables



Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal — not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption — without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training — but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have





VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure — formats, ratios, placements





Who fits here





You think like a marketer, not just a creative — you care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard — you take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer — you communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal — we'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same





What we offer



This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:





Access to a premium AI tool stack — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more, all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks — you'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path — clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty — we're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us





How to apply



Read this part carefully — applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed.





Portfolio. Link 3–5 ad edits you're proud of. DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred. If something ran and performed, tell us the result.

title: Landing Page Specialist
description:
Landing Page Specialist (CRO-Focused)



SALARY + PERFORMANCE BASED 



About the Role:

We are looking for a Landing Page Specialist who understands that a landing page is not a brochure — it is a conversion system. Your job is to close the gap between ad click and purchase (or lead). You will own the design, copy, and continuous optimization of every landing page we run traffic to across Meta and Google campaigns.

If you think a "good-looking" page is the goal, this is not the role for you. If you obsess over above-the-fold messaging, page speed, and why a visitor didn't convert, keep reading.

What You Will Do:

Design, build, and iterate high-converting landing pages for paid traffic (Meta, Google) across product pages, advertorials, lead gen pages, and VSLs.

Ensure every page is tightly aligned to the ad that sent the visitor there — matching the hook, the angle, and the offer. Message match is non-negotiable.

Write or closely collaborate on conversion copy: headlines, subheads, benefit stacks, objection handling, social proof, and CTAs.

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests with clear hypotheses, proper statistical significance thresholds, and documented learnings.

Optimize for page speed and Core Web Vitals, as both directly affect Quality Score on Google and conversion rates across all channels.

Analyze heatmaps, session recordings, and funnel drop-off data (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or equivalent) to identify friction points and prioritize fixes.

Build landing page variants tailored to different funnel stages — top-of-funnel prospecting traffic requires a fundamentally different page than bottom-of-funnel retargeting traffic.

Who You Are:

Copy-First Thinker: You understand that design serves copy, not the other way around. You know that the headline is responsible for the majority of conversion outcomes and you treat it accordingly.

Analytically Rigorous: You do not declare a test a winner based on gut feel or small sample sizes. You understand statistical significance and know when to call a test and when to let it run.

Platform-Proficient: You are hands-on with at least one major page builder (Replo, GemPages, Pagefly, Unbounce, or Webflow) and can move fast without sacrificing quality.

Funnel-Aware: You understand how the landing page fits into the broader acquisition funnel. You know what a Media Buyer needs from you and you can translate ad creative angles into page structure.

Speed-Obsessed: You know that a 1-second delay in page load time can meaningfully reduce conversions and you treat performance optimization as a core responsibility, not an afterthought.

Requirements:

Portfolio of landing pages with documented conversion rate improvements (before/after data required — no portfolio without performance data will be considered).

Proficiency in at least one page builder platform (Replo, GemPages, Pagefly, Unbounce, Webflow, or similar).

Working knowledge of CRO principles: above-the-fold optimization, trust signals, social proof hierarchy, urgency/scarcity mechanics, and offer framing.

Familiarity with heatmap and session recording tools (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or equivalent).

Basic understanding of how Google Ads Quality Score and Meta ad relevance diagnostics are affected by landing page experience.

Excellent written English — you will be writing or editing copy directly.

To Apply:

Please include the phrase "Message Match First" at the top of your application. Along with your resume, attach or link to 2–3 landing pages you have built, and for each one, include the conversion rate before and after your involvement. Applications without performance data will not be reviewed.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)
description:
Title:

AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property-tech, remote)



Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Strategic Project Manager – EV Infrastructure & Vehicle Inspection
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an analytical, process-driven Strategic Project Manager to act as the primary gatekeeper and operational architect for our upcoming initiatives. In this role, you will evaluate incoming opportunities in the EV charging station and vehicle inspection spaces, analyzing them against our strategic goals and past performance to determine viability ("Should we pursue this project?").



You won't just manage timelines—you will be responsible for deconstructing complex project scopes, identifying technical and utility requirements, reviewing or creating winning commercial proposals, and designing step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The ideal candidate combines a background in technical project management (infrastructure, utilities, or fleet operations) with a rigorous approach to process standardisation.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Project Evaluation & Feasibility Analysis (Go/No-Go)



Critically evaluate new project leads for charging station installations and vehicle inspection programs to assess financial profitability, technical viability, and operational capacity.



Review prospective station sites or fleet sizes against our historical data to advise leadership on whether a project makes strategic sense to pursue.



Factor in variables like utility grid capacity, local zoning laws, inspection volume, and regional compliance factors during initial evaluation phases.



2. Technical Scope Breakdown & Requirements Gathering



Deconstruct high-level project requests into highly technical, executable project scopes.



Map out exact requirements for EV charging deployment (e.g., electrical load demands, transformer upgrades, hardware/software interoperability, ADA compliance).



Identify exact criteria for vehicle inspection setups (e.g., diagnostic tool integration, physical lane layouts, safety testing compliance, data management systems).



Pinpoint project bottlenecks, supply chain constraints (hardware lead times), and permitting risks early on.



3. Proposal Creation & Review



Draft thorough, professional project proposals, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and Statements of Work (SOWs) for clients, municipal entities, or enterprise fleet partners.



Conduct strict reviews of internally created proposals to ensure cost estimates, deployment timelines, and resource allocations are realistic and protect the company from scope creep.



4. Process Optimization & SOP Development



Build out a library of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for newly approved projects to ensure seamless, highly repeatable field execution.



Author SOPs for charging station installation, site commissioning, safety testing, and post-install maintenance.



Create standardized workflows, inspection checklists, and software training SOPs for vehicle inspection technicians to ensure quality control and regulatory compliance.



Qualifications & Experience:

Experience: 4+ years of project management or operations management experience, specifically within EV charging infrastructure, civil/electrical construction, fleet management, or automotive service/inspection programs.



Analytical Assessment: Strong ability to read technical site plans, utility sheets, or fleet specifications and make data-driven decisions on project feasibility.



Documentation Excellence: Proven track record of drafting complex proposals, SOWs, and creating highly structured, clear SOPs for technical workflows.



Regulatory/Technical Knowledge: * Familiarity with EV charging infrastructure (Level 2 & DC Fast Charging, utility interconnection, permitting).



Familiarity with automotive/vehicle inspection standards, diagnostic equipment, or compliance regulations is a major asset.



Tools: Proficiency with project management platforms (e.g., ClickUp, Asana, Jira, Monday.com) and visual process mapping tools (e.g., Lucidchart, Miro).



Certification: PMP, Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), or CAPM is highly preferred.



Who You Are:

The Strategic Gatekeeper: You know how to look past the excitement of a new deal and evaluate whether it actually makes financial and operational sense for the team to execute.



Detail-Obsessed: You care about the nuance of a utility grid connection or the exact calibration steps of a vehicle inspection tool, ensuring no detail is missed in the scope.



A Process Creator: You thrive on turning a chaotic, "one-off" project execution into a repeatable, step-by-step SOP system that anyone on the team can follow.



An Effective Communicator: You can easily align utility companies, electrical contractors, inspection technicians, and executive stakeholders on a singular vision.

This project previously failed because the freelancer could edit video but could not deliver the required VFX. Please do not apply for this project unless you can show real examples of comparable VFX, water effects, 3D text integration, or advanced AI/VFX work.

This is a brand / USP video explaining the emotional and commercial idea behind CruiseLife.

or

or

________________________________________

What We Need From You

• Strong English communication 

• Ability to work from a detailed storyboard/script

________________________________________

Required Application Details

________________________________________

• “This part needs VFX.” 

• “This part should be filmed.” 

• “This part is risky.” 

• “This is the best workflow.” 

• “Here is a small test before we continue.” 

Honesty and technical judgment are more important than overpromising.

________________________________________

First Step / Test

Before awarding the full project, we may request a short paid test scene.

For Video 1, this could be a 5–10 second sample showing wave / water / 3D wordmark integration.

For Video 2, this could be a 10–15 second sample scene showing the intended style, pacing, stock/AI/filmed material approach, and overall brand feeling.

________________________________________

Brand Context

CruiseLife is a lifestyle and fashion brand. The tone should be:

• Positive 

• Sunny 

• Elegant 

• Emotional 

• Aspirational 

• Premium but not arrogant 

• Suitable for international marketing 

The goal is to create video content that feels like a real brand campaign, not like a cheap AI experiment.

________________________________________

Please Do Not Apply If

• You only create basic AI videos without editing skill 

• You only use stock footage 

• You cannot do or coordinate VFX 

• You cannot follow a detailed storyboard 

• You cannot communicate clearly in English 

• You cannot show relevant examples

________________________________________

Final Deliverables

Final deliverables should include:

• Version suitable for website / social media

title: Media Buying
description:
Senior Media Buyer (Meta & Google Ads Specialist)



PAYMENT IS SALARY + PERFORMANCE!!



About the Role:

We are looking for an elite Media Buyer who understands that the landscape of paid acquisition has fundamentally changed. We don’t need someone who just pushes buttons or relies on outdated targeting hacks. We need a strategic operator who understands that on Meta, creative is the new targeting, and on Google, profitability (ROAS) and market dominance are the ultimate metrics.

If you understand the implications of Meta’s Andromeda retrieval system and know how to systematically scale Google Ads from proof-of-concept to aggressive growth, we want you on our team.

What You Will Do:



Meta Ads (Post-Andromeda Strategy):

Manage and scale Meta campaigns using Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC) and broad targeting structures.

Implement creative-led scaling. You know that finding a "winning ad" isn't enough; you must continuously feed the machine with conceptually distinct creatives (varying angles, formats, and personas) to avoid Entity ID overlap and creative fatigue.

Manage budget allocation based on the
rule (proven winners, variations, fresh concepts).

Diagnose stalled delivery by analyzing hook rates, hold rates, frequency, and signal quality, rather than just tweaking ad set targeting.



Google Ads (Performance & Scaling):

Build and optimize Google Search and Performance Max (PMax) campaigns with a strict focus on profitability and total revenue.

Execute systematic keyword research (finding the 2-4 word "sweet spot") and ensure tight ad relevance and landing page alignment.

Transition campaigns from Max Conversions/Manual CPC to tROAS/tCPA once proof of concept is established.

Manage aggressive scaling strategies, monitoring key market dominance metrics like Search Impression Share, Absolute Top %, and Click Share.

Maintain data integrity by properly segmenting branded vs. non-branded traffic and ensuring accurate tracking across the funnel.



Who You Are:

Deeply Analytical & Creative: You understand that media buying is now a blend of data analysis and creative strategy. You can brief creative teams based on performance data and psychological triggers/barriers.



Systematic & Disciplined: You don't make emotional changes to campaigns. You respect learning phases (minimum 50-75 conversions on Meta) and scale budgets systematically (e.g., 20-30% bumps on Google).



A Continuous Learner: You stay up-to-date with the bleeding edge of ad tech. You know why interest stacking is dead on Meta and how to properly structure a PMax campaign without cannibalizing search.



Fluent in the Metrics that Matter: You look past vanity metrics. You speak the language of MER (Marketing Efficiency Ratio), Thumbstop Ratio, and true CPA.



Requirements:

Proven track record of managing profitable Meta and Google Ads campaigns (portfolio/case studies required).

Deep understanding of Meta's current retrieval engine (Andromeda) and Google's automated bidding strategies.

Experience with tracking and attribution tools (e.g., Triple Whale, Northbeam, GA4, Server-Side Tracking).

Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.



To Apply:

Please include the phrase "Creative is Targeting" at the top of your application so we know you read this description. Along with your resume, please provide a brief summary of a time you successfully scaled a campaign using a creative-led strategy on Meta or a structured scaling approach on Google.

title: Google Ads Specialist (Lead Generation & E-Commerce)
description:
Part-Time Initially (Potential to Grow)





We are looking for a highly capable Google Ads Specialist to join our team on a part-time basis.



This is not a button-pushing role.



We already have successful Google Ads systems running across multiple client accounts. We are looking for someone who can understand what is already working, identify opportunities for improvement, and help us expand our capabilities across the Google advertising ecosystem.



You will initially work across a small number of accounts and be responsible for auditing campaigns, identifying opportunities, making recommendations, and implementing optimizations.



As the role grows, you may become responsible for additional accounts and helping us develop new Google Ads offerings.



---



## What We're Looking For



### Required



* Strong hands-on Google Ads experience

* Proven experience generating leads through Google Ads

* Experience managing Search campaigns

* Experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM)

* Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

* Strong understanding of conversion tracking and attribution

* Ability to audit and improve landing pages and funnels

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

---



## What Success Looks Like



We are looking for someone who can:



* Audit existing campaigns and identify opportunities

* Understand our current acquisition systems

* Improve campaign performance through testing and optimization

* Recommend new strategies and channels where appropriate

* Improve tracking and attribution accuracy

* Identify opportunities within Search, Display, YouTube, Remarketing and Performance Max

* Audit landing pages and conversion paths

* Think strategically rather than simply making changes inside an ad account

* Present recommendations clearly and logically



---



## Initial Project



As part of the hiring process, shortlisted candidates will be asked to review one of our existing Google Ads accounts and provide:

What do you believe the current acquisition strategy is?

This exercise is designed to identify strategic thinkers who can understand an existing system before proposing changes.

title: Amazon Private Label Creative Designer & Video Editor

Position: Amazon Private Label Creative Designer & Video Editor

Compensation: Part-time or project-based rate depending on portfolio quality, direct Amazon private label creative experience, video editing ability, and workload. Full-time equivalent range: PHP 25,000 - 60,000/month.





About Us



We are a Canadian company building Amazon FBA private label and wholesale operations in the United States and Canada. We are looking for an Amazon private label creative designer who can support product launches with strong Amazon listing images, A+ Content, packaging visuals, product inserts, mockups, videos, and other launch-related creatives.



This is not a general graphic design role. We need someone with direct Amazon private label creative experience.





Experience Level Required



We are looking for an intermediate to senior-level creative designer with 2+ years of direct Amazon private label creative design experience.



Candidates should already understand Amazon listing image structure, product infographics, A+ Content, comparison charts, feature/benefit visuals, product image editing, packaging visuals, and conversion-focused Amazon product presentation.





Portfolio Required



Applications without relevant Amazon listing image, A+ Content, product image, packaging, ad creative, or product video samples will not be prioritized.





Role Overview



You will help create end-to-end creative assets for Amazon FBA private label product launches. The work may include listing image sets, product infographics, A+ Content, product mockups, packaging visuals, inserts, short product videos, ad creatives, and other Amazon launch-related assets.



The main goal is to make physical products look clear, premium, trustworthy, and conversion-focused on Amazon.





Key Responsibilities



• Design complete Amazon listing image sets, including main image concepts, secondary images, benefit images, product-in-use visuals, bundle visuals, and comparison graphics.

• Create product infographics showing features, dimensions, materials, benefits, use cases, bundle contents, and customer pain-point solutions.

• Design A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content, brand story visuals, comparison modules, and product education graphics.

• Create packaging concepts, box mockups, labels, inserts, thank-you cards, instruction cards, and other printed assets.

• Edit supplier images, sample photos, product photos, lifestyle images, and raw product visuals for Amazon use.

• Create or edit short product videos, product demo videos, listing videos, ad-style videos, and launch creatives when needed.

• Create ad creatives, promo graphics, storefront visuals, banners, icons, badges, and other Amazon brand assets.

• Use AI tools when useful for creative ideation, mockups, image support, video support, and workflow speed, while checking quality and accuracy.

• Keep creative files, source files, exports, versions, and references organized in Google Drive.

• Communicate clearly about completed work, design notes, missing assets, blockers, revisions, and next steps.





Requirements



• 2+ years of direct Amazon private label creative design experience required, including Amazon listing images, product infographics, A+ Content, product image editing, comparison charts, packaging visuals, inserts, product mockups, and/or Amazon product videos.

• Intermediate to senior-level design ability required.

• Strong portfolio required.

• Strong static design ability required.

• Basic-to-intermediate video editing ability strongly preferred.

• Experience with tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma, CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, AI image/video tools, or similar tools.

• Good understanding of Amazon product presentation, listing image structure, layout, typography, image clarity, visual hierarchy, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to create clean, professional, premium-looking visuals for physical products.

• Strong attention to detail with spelling, product claims, dimensions, packaging text, image sizes, file formats, and revisions.

• Organized, reliable, responsive, and comfortable working independently.





Not Suitable For



This role is not suitable for candidates whose experience is mainly general VA work, customer service, basic Canva templates, logo-only design, or social-media-only graphics. We are looking for someone with strong Amazon private label product creative ability.





How to Apply



To apply, start your message with:



“Amazon Creative Designer”



Then include:



1. Your portfolio link

2. Your direct Amazon private label creative experience

3. Your experience with listing images, infographics, A+ Content, packaging, inserts, mockups, and video

5. Your expected rate

title: Outbound Sales — Phone Closer | Cebu | Full-Time
description:
This is a phone sales role. You call people, you qualify fast, you close or you move on. That's the job.



We sell a product that protects elderly people at home. The category is growing, the product works, and the partners we've signed prove it has legs. You don't need to know more than that until you can prove you can sell.



**The job**



80–120 outbound dials daily across USA time zones. You'll speak to adult children worrying about a parent, or the seniors themselves. You'll identify urgency in under 60 seconds and either push toward a close or cut the call. No handholding, no long sales cycles, no committee decisions.



**What gets you an interview**



5+ years closing B2C on the phone. You know your numbers cold — close rate, average call length, monthly revenue generated. You've sold something people didn't know they needed and made them believe they did. Your English is clean and your accent doesn't get in the way.



**What kills your application immediately**



Sending a CV with no numbers on it. Describing yourself as a "team player." Having 5 years of experience that's actually the same year repeated five times.





**Apply**



Send a 90-second voice note. Tell us your best month in sales, what you were selling, and what made that month happen. Nothing else needed.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager — Role & Playbook

Business: Website design for restaurants & local businesses Platforms: Instagram (primary), TikTok,
 The one job: Grow a relevant audience and turn it into DMs ? qualified leads ? paying clients.



The Goal (read this first)

Follower count is not the goal. The goal is DMs from restaurant owners that turn into paying clients. A 2,000-follower account full of local restaurant owners beats a 50,000-follower account full of random people every single time. At the same time this does not mean we do not want to grow the account the more followers we have the higher chance we can turn viewers and followers into leads.

Every post must do one of three jobs: get discovered (Top of Funnel), build trust (Middle of Funnel), or drive a DM (Bottom of Funnel). If a post does none of these, don't post it.

North-star metric: number of qualified DMs / leads passed to the owner per week. Secondary metrics: shares, saves, profile visits, follower growth (relevant followers only). Vanity metrics to ignore: raw likes, total followers without context.



The Funnel — what to post and how much

Use this mix as the default. Early on (under ~2k followers) lean heavier on Top of Funnel to grow reach; once the audience builds, shift more toward Middle and Bottom.

Funnel tier

% of posts

Goal

Metric that proves it worked

Top (TOFU)

~50%

Get discovered by people who don't know us

Reach, shares, new follows

Middle (MOFU)

~30%

Prove we know our stuff

Saves, comments, profile visits

Bottom (BOFU)

~20%

Turn warm followers into DMs

DMs, link clicks, leads



TOP OF FUNNEL — Viral Hooks, Broad Topics, Shares

Purpose: reach strangers and get shared. These are broad, visual, and satisfying. No selling.

Content types:

Before/after redesigns of real restaurant sites

"Redesigning a real local restaurant" series — pick a local spot with a bad site, rebuild it, reveal the transformation (this is the flagship format)

Speed builds — sped-up "watch me build a restaurant site in 60 seconds"

Broad relatable hooks about bad restaurant websites

Hook bank (the first 1–2 seconds d
 everything):

"This restaurant has amazing food and a website that's quietly killing their business."

"I redesigned a local restaurant's website without them asking — here's what I changed."

"POV: you Google a restaurant and this is their website."

"Your restaurant's website is losing you customers every day. Here's proof."

MIDDLE OF FUNNEL — Education, Frameworks, Saves

Purpose: convince people who found us that we're the expert. Useful enough to save and send to a friend.

Content types:

Frameworks: "5 things every restaurant website needs (most miss #3)"

Mistakes: "3 things wrong with most restaurant websites"

Myth-busting: "Why relying on just a
 page is costing you money"

Mini-explainers: online ordering, mobile speed, Google rankings — in plain English

Hook bank:

"5 things every restaurant website needs — most are missing at least two."

"The 3-second test: if your site fails this, you're losing diners."

"Stop relying on DoorDash for your online presence. Here's why."

BOTTOM OF FUNNEL — Client Wins, Hard Pitches, DMs

Purpose: turn warm followers into conversations. Direct, proof-driven, with a clear next step.

Content types:

Client wins / results: "We rebuilt [restaurant]'s site and their online orders went up — here's how."

Transparent breakdowns: "Here's exactly what we did for this restaurant and what it cost."

Direct offers: the comment-to-DM play (below)

Hook bank:

"We rebuilt this restaurant's website. Look at the difference."

"Comment SITE and I'll send you a free preview of your restaurant's new website."

"Want to see what your restaurant's site could look like? DM us 'WEBSITE'."



The Weekly Posting Schedule

Start at 5 posts/week (one per weekday), batched and scheduled a week ahead. Same vertical video gets posted to all three platforms — produce once, repurpose everywhere.

Day

Funnel

Post

Monday

TOFU

Before/after of a recent build

Tuesday

MOFU

Educational framework / mistakes post

Wednesday

TOFU

Redesign series — Part 1 (the bad site + "let's fix it")

Thursday

BOFU

Client win / testimonial / results

Friday

TOFU

Redesign series — Part 2 (the reveal) + soft CTA



Rotate so that over two weeks you hit roughly 6 TOFU, 2 MOFU, 2 BOFU. To push more leads, swap a TOFU slot for a second BOFU once the audience is warm.



The Social Media Manager's Exact Responsibilities

Every week (planning — sent to owner for approval)

Build the week's content calendar: what posts, which funnel tier, what day.

Write the script and hook for each post (the spoken/on-screen lines).

Write the caption and CTA for each post.

Edit the raw footage the owner provides into finished vertical reels — captions, hook on screen, trending audio, tight pacing, strong first frame.

Schedule every post across Instagram, TikTok, and
.

Every day

Confirm the scheduled post went live on all three platforms.

Engage in the first 60 minutes after posting — reply to every comment (this is when reach is d
).

Reply to all DMs. Qualify lightly, log every lead in the tracker, and flag warm ones to the owner immediately.

Spend 20–30 min commenting on target accounts — local restaurants, local business pages, food bloggers — to get the account in front of the right people.

Every month

Report: follower growth, top posts, saves/shares, DMs, leads passed. Note what worked and adjust the mix.



How to Gain REAL Followers (not junk)

Tag the restaurant in every redesign. When you feature a real local spot, tag them — they often reshare to their own followers (their customers and other owners). This is the single best source of relevant reach.

Use local + niche tags: location tags for the city/region, plus restaurant/local-business hashtags. Skip giant generic tags.

Reply to every comment and DM. Conversation tells the algorithm the content matters, and it builds real relationships.

Be consistent. 5 posts every week beats 15 one week and none the next.

Never buy followers, likes, or use engagement pods. It poisons your reach and brings zero buyers.



The DM ? Lead Handoff (where the money is)

This is the whole point. The conversion mechanic:

BOTTOM-of-funnel posts end with a comment-to-DM call to action — "Comment SITE and I'll send you a free preview."

Use a tool like ManyChat to auto-DM everyone who comments the keyword. This spikes engagement and drops a warm lead straight into the inbox.

The SMM responds, asks 1–2 light qualifying questions (restaurant name, do they have a site now), and logs the lead in the tracker.

Anyone who shows real interest gets flagged to the owner to close.

Every DM is a potential client. The SMM's job is to start the conversation and hand the owner someone ready to talk.



What the Owner Provides

The SMM can't build the websites — that's you. Your weekly input is small:

Raw footage: screen recordings of builds, before/after captures, the occasional talking-head hook. Batch it once a week into a shared folder.

Approve the calendar the SMM sends.

Close the warm leads the SMM hands you.



Tools

Scheduling:Google Calendar (or the free native Instagram/TikTok schedulers)

Editing: CapCut

Comment-to-DM automation: ManyChat

Content calendar + lead log: Google Sheets or Notion (shared with the owner)



The Rule That Keeps Everyone Honest

Posts are judged by leads, not likes. A post with 200 likes and zero DMs failed. A post with 30 likes that produced two DMs from restaurant owners succeeded. Optimize relentlessly for the conversation, not the applause. We still do need followers, likes, and shares. It is not okay to not get leads or likes.

title: Marketplace Multichannel specialist
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job. You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.



About the Role

We are looking for a multi-channel listing specialist who can build, launch, and optimize product listings across five very different marketplaces: Shopify, Walmart, Target, eBay, and Wayfair.

This is a listings-focused role. You will not be running ads or managing inventory sync — your job is to make sure every product we sell shows up clean, accurate, optimized, and conversion-ready on every channel where it lives.

You understand that each marketplace plays by its own rules. Shopify gives you total creative control. Walmart and Target demand strict content compliance and category-specific attribute precision. eBay rewards keyword density and item specifics. Wayfair is its own world of merchandising, dimensions, and class-level requirements. You know how to switch contexts and execute correctly on all five.

You are the person who asks every week:

• “Which listings are underperforming, and on which channel?”

• “Where are we missing keywords, attributes, or images?”

• “Which listings are flagged, suppressed, or non-compliant?”

• “Where is the biggest optimization opportunity this week?”

What You Will Own

Shopify

• Build product pages with SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, and meta data

• Manage collections, tags, and product organization

• Configure variants, options, and inventory display

• Optimize images, alt text, and structured data for search

• Coordinate with design team on PDP layout, badges, and on-page assets

Walmart Marketplace

• Create and maintain item setups via Item Spec or bulk upload

• Optimize titles, key features, descriptions, and rich media

• Ensure full attribute completeness (Walmart’s Listing Quality Score)

• Manage category-specific compliance and content scorecards

• Resolve content errors, item processing failures, and unpublished items

Target Plus

• Build item setup files following Target’s strict content guidelines

• Write titles and copy that match Target’s brand voice and guest tone

• Manage attribute completeness, images, and enhanced content

• Work within Target Plus Partners portal to maintain item status

• Coordinate item approval and resubmission workflows

eBay

• Build listings with optimized titles (80-character usage) and complete item specifics

• Write keyword-rich descriptions structured for eBay’s search algorithm

• Use eBay’s product catalog and category-specific required fields correctly

• Manage variation listings, store categories, and promotional content

• Monitor and improve listing quality, search visibility, and Best Match positioning

Wayfair

• Build product feeds with accurate class, dimensions, materials, and merchandising attributes

• Write Wayfair-style titles, marketing copy, and bullet features that convert in their PDP layout

• Manage image requirements, lifestyle imagery, and dimension diagrams

• Resolve content rejection issues and class-level data gaps

• Maintain product data quality scores within the Wayfair Partner Home dashboard

Cross-Channel Quality & Reporting

• Maintain a master content library so titles, copy, images, and attributes stay consistent across channels

• Adapt content to each channel’s rules — never copy-paste the same listing everywhere

• Audit existing listings on every channel for gaps, errors, and optimization opportunities

• Track listing health and content scorecards on every platform

• Build a weekly status report showing active, pending, suppressed, and flagged listings by channel

Who You Are

You are not a generalist VA. You are:

• A multi-channel listing operator who has worked in at least 3 of these 5 platforms hands-on

• Fluent in the language of product data: titles, attributes, item specifics, taxonomy, GTINs, variants

• Detail-obsessed — a missing attribute or wrong category is a personal offense

• A strong writer who can shift tone between Shopify, Target, eBay, and Wayfair without thinking about it

• Comfortable working inside multiple seller portals every day

• Calm under spreadsheet pressure — you can manage hundreds of SKUs without losing track

• Self-directed — you flag issues, propose fixes, and execute without hand-holding

Required Experience

• 3+ years building and optimizing product listings on marketplaces and Shopify

• Hands-on experience in at least 3 of the following: Shopify, Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, eBay, Wayfair

• Working knowledge of marketplace content quality requirements and scorecards

• Strong copywriting skills for product titles, bullets, and descriptions

• Comfortable with bulk uploads, item setup templates, and feed files (CSV / Excel)

• Strong spreadsheet skills (formulas, lookups, pivots)

• Working knowledge of product taxonomy, GTINs, UPCs, and category attribute structures

• Experience coordinating with design teams on image requirements per channel

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full content audit completed across all 5 channels

• Master content library built and maintained as source of truth

• Prioritized optimization backlog in motion, by channel

• Listing quality scores improved on Walmart, Target, and Wayfair

• Weekly multi-channel status report established with leadership

• Clear playbook documented for launching a new product across all 5 channels

Why This Role Matters

Every channel we sell on is a storefront, and every storefront is judged on its weakest listing. The right person in this seat protects our brand, lifts conversion across the board, and turns five marketplaces into five well-run businesses instead of five neglected ones.

Work Hours

Monday through Friday, Pacific Standard Time.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• Which of the 5 channels you have the most experience on, and how long

• A specific listing you built or optimized — what you changed, and the result

• The biggest difference, in your view, between writing a Shopify product page and a Walmart listing

title: Amazon Listing Growth Specialist (DataDive Expert Required)
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job.  You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.  



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.  

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.  









We are looking for a senior Amazon listing operator who knows how to launch, rank, and scale products on Amazon — not just write copy. You live inside DataDive, Helium 10, and Brand Analytics, and you can read a niche the way most people read a book.



You will own the full lifecycle of our Amazon listings: from keyword research and competitive analysis on day one, through launch, ranking, and ongoing optimization. You will be responsible for the data-driven decisions that move our products up the page.



You are the person who answers every week:

• “Which keywords are we winning, losing, or missing?”

• “Why did this listing drop in rank?”

• “What is the next listing we should optimize, and why?”

• “Where is the next growth opportunity in this category?”



What You Will Own

Keyword Research & Competitive Analysis

• Run deep keyword research in DataDive (Cerebro-style reverse ASIN, competitor gap analysis, keyword opportunity scoring)

• Build keyword master lists segmented by priority, search volume, relevance, and competition

• Identify untapped long-tail and high-intent keywords competitors are missing

• Analyze competitor listings, reviews, pricing, and ranking patterns

• Map the competitive landscape for every product line

New Listing Launch

• Build SEO-optimized titles, bullets, descriptions, and backend search terms

• Write A+ Content briefs and Brand Story modules

• Coordinate image and infographic briefs with the design team

• Develop launch strategy: pricing, coupons, vine, PPC seeding, and ranking plan

• Set up parent/child variations correctly the first time

• Track launch performance against ranking and revenue targets



Ongoing Listing Optimization

• Audit existing listings for keyword gaps, indexing issues, and conversion leaks

• Run structured A/B tests on titles, main images, and copy using Manage Your Experiments

• Monitor keyword rank movements and respond to ranking drops fast

• Refresh listings based on seasonality, trends, and new competitor moves

• Improve conversion rate, session-to-purchase ratio, and click-through rate



Brand Analytics & Seller Central Intelligence

• Pull and interpret Search Query Performance, Top Search Terms, and Market Basket reports

• Identify share-of-voice gaps vs. top competitors in each category

• Track conversion share, click share, and purchase share by keyword

• Use Seller Central data to validate or challenge DataDive findings

• Flag listing health issues: suppressions, Buy Box loss, policy warnings, stranded inventory



Reporting & Dashboards



You will build and maintain:

• Weekly keyword rank tracker (organic and sponsored)

• Listing health scorecard by ASIN

• Competitor watchlist with movement alerts

• Launch performance reports vs. plan

• Optimization backlog with projected impact and priority



Who You Are



You are not a generalist Amazon VA. You are:

• A senior Amazon operator who has launched and scaled real products — not just edited listings

• A true DataDive power user (this is non-negotiable)

• Deeply analytical — you make decisions from data, not from gut feel

• Obsessive about keyword indexing, ranking, and conversion

• Comfortable reading Search Query Performance reports and explaining what they mean

• Up to date on Amazon algorithm changes, policy updates, and category trends

• A strong written communicator who can brief designers, copywriters, and leadership clearly

• Self-directed — you bring opportunities to the table, you don’t wait to be told



Required Experience

• 5+ years managing Amazon listings at a senior or lead level

• Proven track record of launching products and ranking them on page 1 for competitive keywords

• Expert-level proficiency in DataDive (required — we will test this)

• Strong working knowledge of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Frankenstein, Index Checker)

• Hands-on experience with Brand Analytics and Seller Central reporting

• Experience writing high-converting Amazon copy and A+ Content briefs

• Experience running Manage Your Experiments (A/B tests) on titles and images

• Strong spreadsheet skills (pivots, lookups, basic modeling)

• Familiarity with Amazon Ads / PPC concepts (you don’t need to run campaigns, but you need to understand them)



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full keyword and competitor audit completed for every active ASIN

• Prioritized optimization backlog built and in motion

• At least one major listing relaunch with measurable rank and conversion lift

• Weekly reporting cadence established with leadership

• Clear launch playbook documented for future product releases



Why This Role Matters

Amazon is a zero-sum game. For every rank position we don’t own, a competitor does. The right person in this seat directly drives revenue — every keyword you win, every conversion point you add, and every launch you nail compounds over months and years.



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• A specific example of a listing you launched or optimized, with the keyword(s) you targeted and the rank/revenue result

• How long you have used DataDive and what you use it for most

• One Amazon listing mistake you see most operators make — and how you avoid it

title: Amazon Listing Growth Specialist (DataDive Expert Required)
description:
PLEASE READ THIS JOB DESCRIPTION CAREFULLY - this job is not for everyone.    



Who We Are



Southshore Fine Linens is a fast-growing bedding brand with over 3,500 SKUs across Amazon, Shopify, and wholesale channels. We operate at scale—and we are serious about growth.

 We are not hiring a Virtual Assistant.

 We are hiring an Amazon operator who understands ranking, search intent, and 

conversion. A long-term employee who wants the stability and growth and understand it only comes with performance and results.



What This Role Really Is



You are responsible for one thing:  GROWING LISTINGS.  



Not maintaining them. Not “updating when asked.”

 

You will:

Diagnose why listings are not ranking

Use data to fix them

title: Voice AI Intake Agent Developer — Retell / Vapi — Phase 1 Standalone Test
description:
Job Type: 

Project-based / paid test first



Project Overview:



I am looking for a Voice AI developer to build a **standalone Phase 1 intake-only voice agent** for a mobile mechanic / field service business.



This is separate from my n8n / FieldPulse / CallTrackingMetrics automation build. Another developer is currently handling the first n8n automation proof test.



For this role, I want to start with a small paid Voice AI test that proves the agent can answer calls, collect basic service request information, classify the call, and produce structured output that can later connect to n8n, CTM, and FieldPulse.



Preferred platforms: **Retell AI or Vapi**. I am open to either, but I want the developer to explain which platform is better for this Phase 1 intake-only use case.



## Important Scope Boundary



This first Voice AI agent is **intake only**.



The agent must not:



* diagnose mechanical problems,

* estimate repair cost,

* quote prices,

* schedule appointments,

* dispatch technicians,

* assign technicians,

* promise arrival times,

* promise same-day service,

* create live FieldPulse jobs,

* make commitments on behalf of the business.



The agent’s job is to collect information and route the call for human review/follow-up.



## What the Agent Should Do



The Voice AI agent should:



* Answer incoming calls professionally.

* Explain that it will collect information so someone can follow up.

* Collect required intake details.

* Classify the call type.

* Flag incomplete calls for human review.

* Produce a transcript, summary, classification, missing fields, and structured JSON output.

* Send or simulate an
 recap and SMS alert during the test.

* Be designed so it can later connect to n8n, CallTrackingMetrics, and FieldPulse.



## Required Intake Fields



The agent should attempt to collect:



* Caller name

* Callback phone number

* Whether the callback number can receive texts

  Suggested wording: “Is this a mobile number we can text if needed?”

* City / ZIP where the vehicle or equipment is located

* Vehicle or equipment description

* Brief description of the issue

* Urgency

* Roadside / safety status

* Existing customer vs. new caller if clear



## Call Classifications



The agent should classify calls into categories such as:



* Qualified service request

* Incomplete intake / needs human review

* Roadside or safety review

* Existing customer follow-up

* Non-service call / sales / spam

* Out-of-area or maybe-out-of-area



For incomplete calls, the agent should list the missing fields and mark the call as:



**Needs Human Review — Incomplete Intake**



## Structured Output



The test should produce structured output that can later be used by n8n.



Example fields should include:



* caller_name

* callback_number

* can_text_callback_number: true / false / null

* city

* zip

* vehicle_or_equipment

* issue_summary

* urgency

* roadside_or_safety_status

* classification

* incomplete_intake

* missing_required_fields

* human_review_required

* transcript

* summary

* recording_or_call_link if available



## First Paid Test Deliverables



For the first paid test, I expect:



1. Voice AI agent configured in my account.

2. Intake-only prompt / rules / behavior.

3. Guardrails to prevent diagnosis, pricing, scheduling, dispatching, or response-time promises.

4. 8–10 sample test calls.

5. Transcript and summary output.

6. Classification and missing-field handling.

7. Structured JSON output.

8.
 recap and SMS alert, or clearly mocked/sample alert output if full alert setup is not included.

9. Final prompt/configuration.

10. Setup notes.

11. Loom walkthrough explaining how the agent works.

12. Explanation of what I can safely edit later myself, such as script wording, approved responses, alert recipients, and minor rule changes.



## Future Expansion



Later phases may include:



* Connection to n8n

* CallTrackingMetrics tracking number integration

* FieldPulse-ready customer/job payloads

* Better alert routing

* More advanced review workflow

* Miro flowchart update for the Voice AI portion



These are not required for the first test unless specifically agreed.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate has experience with:



* Retell AI and/or Vapi

* Voice AI prompt design

* Intake call agents

* Call classification

* Webhooks

* JSON outputs

* n8n or Make

* Twilio or SMS alert workflows

* CRM or field service workflow integrations

* Human-review routing

* Clear documentation and Loom walkthroughs



Direct experience with FieldPulse or CallTrackingMetrics is helpful but not required.



## Please Answer These Questions



Start your reply with:



**I can build the Voice AI intake agent.**



Then answer:



1. Have you built voice agents using Retell, Vapi, or another voice AI platform?

2. Which platform do you recommend for this Phase 1 intake-only agent, and why?

3. How would you prevent the agent from diagnosing, estimating, scheduling, dispatching, assigning technicians, or promising response times?

4. How would you handle incomplete calls and missing required fields?

5. Can you produce structured JSON output for future n8n integration?

6. Can you include the field `can_text_callback_number: true / false / null`?

7. Can you send or simulate
 recap and SMS alert output during the test?

8. What accounts/access would you need fro
 before starting?

9. Can the agent be built inside my account so I own the configuration?

10. What simple things would I be able to edit later myself?

11. Can you provide a Loom walkthrough at the end?

12. What fixed price and timeline would you quote for the first paid test?

13. Are you willing to send a short video reply before I make a final decision?



## Budget



Please quote a fixed price for the first paid test.



I am not looking for a full production system yet. I want a small controlled proof test first. If the test goes well, there may be additional work.

title: E-commerce Finance & Bookkeeping Manager
description:
About the Role



Our e-commerce businesses need a sharp, dependable finance person to own our day-to-day money operations. Think invoices and payments, our accounts-payable inbox, QuickBooks upkeep, reconciliations across Wise, PayPal, banks and processors, inventory tracking, reporting, and a hand in cash-flow forecasting down the line.

A heads-up: this isn't a checklist job. We're after someone who takes real ownership — spots the thing that looks off, digs into discrepancies, and flags surprises before they snowball.



What You'll Own



Invoices & accounts payable



Run the accounts-payable Gmail inbox and keep it organized with labels

Track vendor and contractor invoices: amounts, currencies, due dates, payment status

Catch duplicates, errors, and anything that smells suspicious



Payments



Prepare payments via Wise, PayPal, and bank accounts

Monitor what's scheduled, paid, failed, or overdue



Books & reconciliation



Keep QuickBooks clean and current

Reconcile banks, credit cards, Wise, PayPal, Shopify, and payment processors

Track Shopify sales, refunds, chargebacks, fees, and payouts

Stay on top of processor reserves, holds, and delayed payouts



Inventory



Track stock levels and movements

Reconcile inventory against Shopify, suppliers, and warehouses

Manage purchase orders, supplier deposits, and incoming stock

Maintain inventory valuation, COGS, and landed-cost records



Reporting & planning



Track ad spend, shipping, fulfillment, software, and processing costs

Deliver weekly and monthly financial reports

Surface unpaid invoices, upcoming payments, and cash needs

Support cash-flow forecasting, budgeting, and planning

Keep documents tidy for accountants and tax season



What We're Looking For



A background in finance, bookkeeping, or accounting

E-commerce or DTC experience, ideally with 7–8 figure revenue brands

Solid QuickBooks skills

Hands-on with Wise, PayPal, Shopify, and online banking

Strong with spreadsheets

Comfortable with inventory, COGS, and reconciliations

Detail-obsessed

High initiative — you solve problems without being told to

Clear written English and reliable follow-through

Trustworthy with sensitive financial information



Speaking Up



When something unexpected happens, we need to hear about it fast. That includes missing or duplicate invoices, odd charges, changes to vendor payment details, failed or delayed payments, missing payouts, reconciliation gaps, processor reserves or account holds, inventory shortfalls, sudden cost spikes, or anything that looks fishy.

A good report covers four things: what happened, the financial impact, what you looked into, and what you'd do next.

What We're Looking For



A background in finance, bookkeeping, or accounting

E-commerce or DTC experience

Solid QuickBooks skills

Hands-on with Wise, PayPal, Shopify, and online banking

Strong with spreadsheets

Comfortable with inventory, COGS, and reconciliations

Detail-obsessed

High initiative — you solve problems without being told to

Clear written English and reliable follow-through

Trustworthy with sensitive financial information



How We Handle Security



You'll prepare payments, but final approval always stays with management. And any change to a vendor's banking details must be independently verified before a payment goes out.



To Apply



Tell us:



-A quick summary of your e-commerce finance or bookkeeping background

-The software and payment platforms you've worked with

-Your experience with QuickBooks, inventory, and reconciliations

-A time you caught and resolved a financial discrepancy

-Your availability and expected hourly rate
