title: Team Lead / Senior Technical QA — Architecture, BIM, or Construction Delivery Background
description:
# Team Lead / Senior Technical QA — Architecture, BIM, or Construction Delivery Background



**Remote | Philippines | Full-Time Contractor**



Oliant is looking for a strong **Team Lead / Senior Technical QA** professional in the Philippines to lead a growing remote team supporting construction technology, AI-assisted workflows, data quality, and project delivery.



This is not a basic QA role. We are looking for someone who understands construction drawings, project delivery, technical coordination, and quality standards — and who can lead a team with structure, patience, accountability, and strong communication.



The ideal candidate may come from an **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, BIM, construction coordination, or technical QA** background.



## About the Role



As a **Team Lead / Senior Technical QA**, you will manage a team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists working across multiple projects. Your main responsibility is to ensure that the team produces accurate, timely, and high-quality work.



You will review project outputs, guide tea
mbers, identify quality issues, improve delivery processes, and act as the first escalation point when something needs clarification or correction.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining technical construction knowledge with people leadership, quality control, and process improvement.



## What You’ll Do



Your responsibilities will include:



* Lead a team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists.

* Own the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of the team’s deliverables.

* Review work before it reaches the client or senior stakeholders.

* Ensure data accuracy, reporting consistency, and adherence to project standards.

* Help tea
mbers interpret construction drawings, 3D models, markups, RFIs, redlines, comments, and other technical documents.

* Support weekly workload planning and help assign tea
mbers based on project needs, skill level, and capacity.

* Maintain internal trackers, project status updates, and delivery documentation.

* Provide structured feedback to tea
mbers.

* Train junior tea
mbers on workflows, drawing interpretation, QA standards, platform usage, and delivery expectations.

* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.

* Escalate blockers, risks, and quality concerns early.

* Coordinate with other remote teams involved in project setup, configuration, mapping, QA, and delivery.

* Participate in client-facing or internal stakeholder meetings when needed.

* Help create a culture of ownership, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.



## What We’re Looking For



You should apply if you have:



* A Bachelor’s degree in **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering**, or a related construction / technical field.

* Strong ability to read and interpret construction drawings, including architectural plans, sections, MEP layouts, structural drawings, fit-out details, and site-related documentation.

* Experience with BIM, construction coordination, project delivery, technical QA, or quality control.

* Experience reviewing technical work for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to catch mistakes before they become client-facing issues.

* Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

* Experience leading, mentoring, training, or coordinating other tea
mbers.

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

* Confidence working with spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and structured project data.

* Ability to learn new tools, platforms, and workflows quickly.



## Helpful Experience



The following experience is helpful, but not all are required:



* Autodesk Revit

* AutoCAD

* Navisworks / NWD model navigation

* BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud

* Bluebeam

* Procore

* Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel

* Primavera P6 or ASTA Powerproject

* Construction progress tracking

* QA process design

* Data validation

* AI-assisted workflows

* Remote team leadership



## Who You Are



We are looking for someone who is:



* Detail-oriented and quality-driven.

* Calm under pressure.

* Clear and respectful when giving feedback.

* Comfortable holding people accountable without micromanaging.

* Proactive in raising risks, blockers, and process gaps.

* Able to explain complex technical issues in simple terms.

* Fair, patient, and supportive with junior tea
mbers.

* Comfortable working with changing priorities.

* Interested in technology, AI, construction data, and modern digital workflows.



## Compensation



* **Starting compensation:** **$950 – $1,100 USD/month**, depending on experience and interview performance.

* **Strong candidates with proven leadership, BIM, construction coordination, or QA management experience may be considered up to:** **$1,200 USD/month**.

* Compensation is reviewed based on performance, reliability, quality of work, leadership, communication, and business needs.



This is a full-time contractor role. Weekend or rest-day work may be required depending on project needs and will be handled separately according to the project schedule and applicable rate structure.



## Role Details



* **Location:** Fully remote, Philippines

* **Type:** Full-time contractor

* **Schedule:** Full-time

* **Seniority:** Lead / Senior Technical QA

* **Reports to:** Delivery / Operations Management

* **Team:** You will help lead a growing team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists.



## Why Join Oliant?



Oliant works with international clients and remote teams across multiple regions. We are building specialized teams around AI-assisted QA, technical validation, construction data, digital workflows, and project delivery.



This is a strong opportunity for someone who wants to move beyond individual production work and grow into a leadership role where quality, communication, process improvement, and team development matter.



You will help shape how the team works, how quality is maintained, and how junior technical talent grows.



## How to Apply



Please send your resume and a short introduction that includes:



1. Your background in Architecture, Engineering, BIM, construction coordination, or QA.

2. The tools you have used, such as Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, BIM 360, Procore, Bluebeam, Excel, or similar platforms.

3. Your experience reviewing drawings, models, reports, or technical project data.

4. Any experience leading, mentoring, training, or coordinating tea
mbers.

5. Your expected monthly compensation in USD.



We are looking for someone who can lead with quality, ownership, and good judgment. If that sounds like you, we would be happy to hear from you.

description:
About the Role



We are an Australian-based private lender seeking a highly detail-oriented Loan Data Analyst with experience working alongside credit decisioning frameworks or rule books.



This role goes beyond basic data review — you will play a key part in structuring financial data in line with credit policy, ensuring our assessors can make fast, consistent, and responsible lending decisions.



Key Responsibilities



• Review and analyse customer bank transaction data (last 90 days)

• Categorise income, expenses, and liabilities in line with internal credit rules

• Apply and interpret credit policy / rulebook guidelines to real customer data

• Identify financial behaviours such as:



Gambling activity

BNPL usage

Payday lending / wage advances

Overdraft reliance

• Prepare clear, structured summaries aligned to decisioning requirements

• Flag inconsistencies, risks, or policy breaches for escalation

• Support continuous improvement of credit rules and data structuring processes

• Maintain strict privacy, confidentiality, and data handling standards

What We’re Looking For



• Experience working with credit rulebooks, decisioning frameworks, or lending policies

• Background in lending, fintech, credit risk, or financial data analysis

• Strong understanding of:



Income verification

Expense analysis

Liability assessment

Responsible lending principles

• Proven ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and risk indicators in transaction data

• High attention to detail and structured thinking

• Ability to follow and apply rules consistently (not just interpret data)

• Strong written English and ability to present clear, logical summaries

Important – Privacy & Data Handling



You will be working with sensitive financial data. All work must be completed in line with strict privacy and confidentiality requirements.

No customer data is to be stored, shared, or used outside of authorised systems.



Application Requirement (Mandatory)



To be considered for this role, you must provide:



A sample of a credit rulebook, decisioning framework, or policy you have previously worked with

This can be anonymised or redacted if required

It should demonstrate how decisions are made (e.g. income rules, expense thresholds, risk flags)

Examples of categorised transaction data, ensuring:

All personal information is removed or anonymised

No real customer names, account numbers, or identifiable details

Clear grouping of transactions (e.g. income, rent, utilities, gambling, BNPL, discretionary spending)



Applications without these examples will not be considered.



Why Join Us?



• Work with a fast-growing Australian lender building a scalable credit model

• Be part of a structured, data-driven decisioning environment

• Long-term opportunity with growth into credit risk and policy development

• High-impact role influencing how lending decisions are made

title: Human Resources (HR) Lead
description:

Your job is to reduce chaos, streamline workflows, and ensure clean execution across HR as we scale.



Key Responsibilities



HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

• Manage onboarding for new hires (offer letters, document collection, file organization)

• Maintain employee records and ensure all documentation is complete and compliant with California employment laws

• Support offboarding processes (terminations, final pay coordination, documentation)

• Track employee status across locations (active, onboarding, terminated)



Payroll Coordination (Paylocity)

• Prepare and coordinate payroll runs

• Handle off-cycle payroll adjustments, corrections, and updates

• Maintain employee data (direct deposit, classifications, etc.)

• Work with U.S. payroll provider (Paylocity) to resolve issues



Systems & Benefits Administration

• Support Paylocity setup and ongoing maintenance (T&L, policies, configurations)

• Assist with benefits coordination (401k, benefit platforms, etc.)

• Troubleshoot system issues and follow up persistently until resolved

• Help document and improve HR/payroll workflows



Compliance & Entity Setup Support

• Assist with: EIN applications, State registrations (e.g., EDD), Business licenses

• Maintain compliance tracking (deadlines, filings, documentation)

• Conduct basic research on HR/payroll/legal requirements as needed



Admin & Operations Support

• Manage shared tools (Google Drive, tracking sheets, task lists)

• Coordinate across tea
mbers (operations, finance, leadership)

• Reduce
 chaos by organizing and executing tasks efficiently

• Ad-hoc personal requests from owner



Reporting & Process Improvement

• Maintain clean tracking sheets for: Payroll status, Onboarding progress, Compliance items

• Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements

• Help build simple, scalable SOPs for all recurring tasks



Ideal Candidate Profile

• 3–6+ years experience working in Human Resources roles.

• Experience working with U.S.-based businesses (required), with experience in California-based businesses a significant nice-to-have

• Familiarity with: Payroll systems (Paylocity strongly preferred); HR processes (onboarding, terminations, employee records)

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Strong written English communication (clear, concise, professional)

• Able to work independently and drive tasks to completion without handholding



Nice to Have

• Experience supporting multi-location or franchise businesses

• Familiarity with tools like: Paylocity, Ramp, Google Sheets (intermediate level)

• Experience improving workflows or building SOPs

• Basic knowledge of U.S. labor/payroll compliance



Success Metrics

• Payroll runs smoothly with minimal errors or rework

• Employee onboarding/offboarding is clean, fast, and fully documented

• Systems (Paylocity, tracking sheets) are clean and up-to-date

Time Tracking

title: Virtual Assistant (VA) Leasing Agent — Reiger World Apartments
description:
SECTION 1 — POSITION OVERVIEW



Position Title:

Virtual Assistant (VA) Leasing Agent — Reiger World Apartments



Reports To:

Property Manager / Collins Properties



Employment Type:

Remote / Contract | Part-Time or Full-Time (based on vacancy volume)



Work Hours:

Monday – Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST | Saturday (as needed for open house support)



Location:

Fully remote — all work performed digitally via
, phone, video, and leasing platforms



Position Summary

The Virtual Assistant (VA) Leasing Agent supports Reiger World Apartments' aggressive 90-day lease-up campaign by managing all remote leasing activities: online listings, lead intake and follow-up, application coordination, digital marketing, and administrative reporting. The VA operates as a high-output remote extension of the on-site leasing team, handling the volume and follow-through that drives occupancy while the on-site agent focuses on tours and closings.

With 23 current vacancies, speed and consistency are critical. The VA is expected to work all active lead channels simultaneously, respond to inquiries within 2 hours, and maintain meticulous records in the leasing pipeline tracker.



SECTION 2 — KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



A. Online Listings & Platform Management

• Manage and refresh listings daily on GoSection8, 
, HousingList, Zillow,
 Marketplace, and Nextdoor

• Upload current unit photos, availability, rates (GPI and concession pricing), and community benefits

• Remove filled units promptly; add new vacancies within 24 hours of notice

• Monitor platfor
ssage inboxes and respond to all inquiries within 2 hours



B. Lead Management & Follow-Up

• Log every incoming lead (source, contact info, unit interest, voucher status) into the pipeline tracker

• Send introduction messages and property info packets to all new inquiries

• Follow up with all unscheduled prospects via phone, text, and
 every 48–72 hours

• Schedule unit tours for the on-site leasing agent; send prospect confirmations and 24-hour reminders

• Track every prospect through the pipeline: New ? Contacted ? Toured ? Applied ? Approved ? Leased



C. Section 8 & Affordable Housing Outreach

• Contact local Dallas-area housing authorities and Section 8 offices to list the property on voucher-holder resources

• Communicate with housing counselors and case managers to identify pre-qualified voucher holders

• Assist applicants with Section 8 paperwork questions; coordinate inspection scheduling with on-site agent

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Dallas Housing Authority payment standards for 1BR and 2BR units



D. Digital Marketing & Social Media

• Create and publish 3–5 social media posts per week 
, Instagram, Nextdoor)

• Promote open houses, concession tiers, and community benefits through digital content

• Boost high-performing posts or listings as directed by Property Manager

• Track engagement metrics and report weekly on which platforms generate the most leads



E. Application & Lease Administration

• Distribute rental applications via
 or online portal to qualified prospects

• Follow up with applicants for missing documentation; track application completeness

• Coordinate with screening vendor for background and credit checks

• Prepare lease packets for approved applicants using Collins Properties templates

• Send leases via DocuSign or HelloSign; track e-signature completion

• Confirm move-in date, deposit receipt, and utility setup with on-site agent



F. Reporting & Communication

• Deliver a daily end-of-day summary
 to Property Manager: leads received, contacts made, tours booked

• Submit a comprehensive weekly leasing report every Friday: KPIs, pipeline status, concession usage, recommendations

• Flag units vacant 30+ days for concession tier upgrade review

• Maintain all records in the shared Collins Properties Google Drive or Buildium file system



SECTION 3 — QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS



Required

• Minimum 1 year of remote administrative, leasing support, or property management experience

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office / Google Workspace (Excel/Sheets, Word/Docs, Gmail)

• Strong written communication skills — professional
s and messages are the primary work product

• Experience managing multiple online platforms simultaneously

• Reliable high-speed internet, computer, and phone/VOIP capability

• Highly organized with the ability to manage a large prospect pipeline independently

• Ability to work US Central Time hours (8 AM – 5 PM CST)



Preferred

• Prior experience with GoSection8, 
, or similar affordable housing listing platforms

• Familiarity with Section 8 / Housing Choice Voucher programs and Dallas Housing Authority processes

• Experience supporting leasing for senior (55+) or affordable housing communities

• Proficiency in DocuSign, HelloSign, or similar e-signature platforms

• Social media content creation and scheduling experience

• Basic knowledge of Buildium, AppFolio, or similar property management software

• Bilingual English/Spanish strongly preferred for serving Dallas-area Section 8 population



SECTION 4 — REQUIRED TOOLS & PLATFORMS



The VA Leasing Agent must be proficient in or able to quickly learn the following:



Category Tools / Platforms

Lead Generation & Listings -  GoSection8, 
, HousingList, Zillow,
 Marketplace, Nextdoor

CRM / Tracking - Google Sheets Vacancy Tracker, Buildium (if granted access), or custom Collins Properties template

Communication -
 (Gmail/Outlook), WhatsApp Business, Google Voice or VOIP line for prospect calls

Social Media -
, Instagram, Nextdoor; Buffer or Meta Business Suite for scheduling

Document Management - Google Drive, DocuSign or HelloSign for e-lease execution, Dropbox for file sharing

Screening Coordination - TransUnion SmartMove, RentPrep, or manager-assigned screening vendor

Project Management - Trello, Asana, or ClickUp for daily task tracking and manager visibility

Reporting - Google Sheets or Excel weekly leasing report;
ed to Collins Properties every Friday



SECTION 5 — COMPENSATION & INCENTIVES



Base Pay Monthly -  retainer or hourly rate based on experience and hours worked

Per-Lease Bonus - $50–$75 per executed lease generated through VA's lead activity

Occupancy Milestone - $250 bonus when property reaches 90% occupancy within 60 days

Referral Conversion - $25 per referral lead that converts to a signed lease

Platform Performance - Bonus eligibility if online inquiry volume increases 25%+ month-over-month



SECTION 6 — PERFORMANCE METRICS (KPIs)



The VA Leasing Agent will be evaluated weekly and monthly on the following metrics:



KPI Metric

Lead Inquiries Logged - Weekly Target 25+, Monthly Target 100+

Tours Booked (for on-site agent), Weekly Target 10+, Monthly Target 40+

Follow-Up Contacts Made - Weekly Target 30+, Monthly Target 120+

Applications Submitted - Weekly Target 5+, Monthly Target 20+

Listing Refreshes Completed - Weekly Target All platforms All platforms

Social Media Posts Published - Weekly Target 3–5, Monthly Targe 12–20

Section 8 / HA Contacts Made - Weekly Target 10+, Monthly Targe 40+

Lease Packets Prepared - Weekly Target Per approvals, Monthly Targe Per approvals

Weekly Report Delivered - Weekly Target Every Friday, Monthly Targe 4x/month

Lead Response Time - Weekly Target < 2 hours, Monthly Targe < 2 hours



SECTION 7 — OPERATING PROTOCOLS & STANDARDS



Communication Standards

• All prospect inquiries must receive a response within 2 hours during business hours

• Use approved Collins Properties
 templates for initial outreach; personalize as appropriate

• Never make lease approval promises — direct applicants to Property Manager for final decisions

• Maintain a professional, warm tone in all communications — remember the target audience is seniors 55+



Data & Confidentiality

• All applicant data (SSN, income, background info) must be handled per Fair Housing and privacy guidelines

• Never store sensitive applicant data on personal devices — use only approved shared drives

• Prospect and tenant contact info is proprietary — not to be shared outside Collins Properties



Escalation Protocol

• Escalate any Fair Housing complaints, threatening communications, or legal questions to Property Manager immediately

• Flag any prospect with unusual circumstances (complex voucher situations, disability accommodations) to on-site agent

• If a listing platform flags the property or suspends a listing, notify manager within 1 hour
salary: Based on experience and hours worked

title: Job Application Research & Recruiting Support Specialist (Remote)
description:
Talent Sourcing & Job Application Coordinator (Remote – Full-Time)



Company: WolfPeak

Position: Talent Sourcing & Job Application Coordinator

Location: Remote

Compensation: $2.65 USD/hour during the initial 3-month probationary period. After successfully completing the 3-month probationary period and meeting performance expectations, compensation will increase to $3.00 USD/hour.



?



About WolfPeak



WolfPeak helps job seekers secure better career opportunities by providing professional job search and application services. Our team researches job openings, identifies the best opportunities for our clients, submits high-quality applications on their behalf, and manages the entire application process from start to finish.



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual who enjoys research, follows instructions carefully, and takes pride in accuracy.



THIS IS NOT A ROLE WHERE YOU ARE SEARCHING FOR JOBS FOR YOURSELF. YOU WILL BE HELPING OUR CLIENTS FIND EMPLOYMENT.



?



Responsibilities



* Research and identify high-quality job opportunities that match each client’s qualifications and preferences.

* Search company career websites, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other job boards for relevant openings.

* Apply to positions through company career portals and job boards.

* Carefully review job descriptions to ensure they meet client requirements.

* Complete job applications accurately and professionally.

* Customize pre-written responses when necessary.

* Maintain detailed application trackers in Google Sheets.

* Record company names, job titles, application links, dates applied, application status, and notes.

* Monitor submitted applications and identify recruiter responses.

* Prevent duplicate applications.

* Follow detailed instructions and internal processes consistently.

* Communicate with the WolfPeak management team regarding completed work, issues, and questions.



?



Qualifications



* Excellent written English.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to follow instructions precisely.

* MUST OWN AN IPHONE (REQUIRED) AS OUR ENTIRE TEAM COMMUNICATES THROUGH IMESSAGE.

* Reliable high-speed internet connection.

* Comfortable using Google Sheets, Google Docs, web browsers, and other online tools.

* Ability to learn new software quickly.

* Strong organizational and time management skills.

* Self-motivated, dependable, and able to work independently.

* Previous experience in recruiting, sourcing, virtual assistance, research, or administrative support is a plus, but not required.



?



Preferred Skills



* Experience navigating LinkedIn, Indeed, and company career websites.

* Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

* Strong internet research skills.

* Ability to identify high-quality job matches based on provided criteria.



?



Compensation



* $2.65 USD/hour during the first 3 months.

* After successfully completing the 3-month probationary period and meeting performance expectations, compensation will increase to $3.00 USD/hour.

* Full-time remote position.



?



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and committed to helping our clients succeed. Accuracy is more important than speed. If you enjoy research, organization, and following structured processes, we’d love to hear from you and become part of the WolfPeak team.

title: Credit Dispute Specialist/ Repair Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Credit Repair Specialist.



We need someone who has a lot of experience removing collections, inquiries, charge-offs, bankruptcies, and all kinds of negative accounts from clients' reports.

title: Senior Bookkeeper (Remote | Philippines)
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a growing U.S.-based company in the construction and building services industry.



This is a high-ownership role reporting directly to the CEO, ideal for someone who can confidently manage full-cycle bookkeeping, support leadership with accurate financial reporting, and help strengthen financial operations in a fast-paced remote environment.



This is more than a traditional bookkeeping role—it’s a strong opportunity for someone who wants long-term growth and the chance to take on broader finance responsibilities over time.



Key Responsibilities

Manage full-cycle bookkeeping and day-to-day accounting operations

Maintain reconciliations, journal entries, general ledger, and month-end close

Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoicing, collections, and vendor payments

Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial reports

Support cash flow tracking, expense management, and financial reporting for leadership

Improve accounting workflows, reporting processes, and internal controls as the business scales

Coordinate with external U.S.-based CPAs, payroll providers, and accounting partners

Provide timely financial support and reporting directly to the COO



Qualifications

5+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience, ideally in a senior-level role

Required: Experience working remotely with U.S.-based companies or leadership teams

Strong understanding of U.S. bookkeeping practices, including reconciliations, month-end close, accruals, and financial reporting

Proven ability to manage full-cycle bookkeeping independently

Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online

Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable

Able to work independently, stay responsive, and manage priorities in a remote environment

High level of integrity and discretion when handling sensitive financial information



Preferred Qualifications

Experience in construction, subcontracting, field services, or project-based businesses

Familiarity with job costing or construction bookkeeping

Experience working with U.S.-based CPAs, payroll providers, and tax/accounting partners

Experience in a growing or founder-led business

Interest in growing into a broader finance leadership role over time

title: Seller Cloud Ecommerce Technical Support

sellers using the SellerCloud platform, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring smooth operations for their online 

sales. This role requires strong technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and a good understanding of e-commerce 

best practices, particularly within the jewelry industry.

listings, specifically in the context of jewelry products.

fulfillment, and other e-commerce processes.

title: Senior video editor
description:
About Blue Zone:

We’re Blue Zone — a rebellious pet nutrition brand from the Netherlands on a mission to give dogs their longest, healthiest lives. We do this with our air-dried, raw-quality dog food that’s as honest as it gets. No marketing fluff. No filler. Just real food, built on truth and transparency.



Now, we’re looking for a *skilled and motivated video editor* to help bring our message to life across digital channels. You’ll be crafting high-converting, emotionally compelling ad creatives that tell our story in a way people actually want to watch.



Your Mission (if you choose to accept it):

You’ll be turning raw content, user-generated videos, brand video’s, and brand messaging into attention demanding content. Think short-form edits, voiceover-led explainer reels — and a whole lot of creativity in between.



We're not your average pet brand. So we don’t want average creatives. We’re growing fast, and we’re here to shake things up.



What We’re Looking For:

- ???? Strong Editing Skills

        You’re a master at Premiere Pro & After Effects and know how to turn raw footage into compelling short-form content. High-quality transitions, pacing, and storytelling are your jam.

- ???? Quick to Learn, Quick to Adapt

     We move fast, so you need to be comfortable with quick feedback loops, tools, and our systems.

    

- ???? Reliable and Communicative

        We don’t micromanage — but we do expect clear communication and fast delivery. If something’s unclear or blocking you, you speak up early.

    

- ???? Eager to Improve

        You’re open to feedback, love to grow, and aren’t precious about revisions. We’ll support your growth with editing guides and brand templates.

    



Must-Haves

- Fluent in English (written + spoken)

- 2+ year of video editing experience

- Tools you already use; After Effects & Premiere Pro

- Solid sense of visual design: spacing, color, contrast, hierarchy

- Comfortable using AI tools

- Minimum availability: 20 hours/week (40h preferred)



What You’ll Get

- A long-term, remote role with a fast-growing brand

- A creative-first team where your input matters & you can make an actual impact

- Freedom to grow your role and responsibilities

- Access to ready-made assets, AI tools, and a clear process

- A company mission worth standing behind (and a few very cute dog photos)



Compensation

- Approx. $1600/month full-time

- Growth opportunities as we scale



How to Apply

1. Complete the form & trial task linked below:

        

    

2. Send your edit along with your portfolio or relevant work

3. Include the code word “Adobo” in the form — so we know you’re paying attention.



We can’t wait to meet you,



Dean



CEO, Blue Zone

title: Amazon Product Sourcing & Research | China Negotiation | 3+ Years PL Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust)

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier, how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

2. Walk me through your evaluation process for a Private Label product - what metrics matter most to you, what makes you say no, and what makes you say yes? Give a real example without naming the product. What's your process, not your tools.

3. What tools do you use daily for Amazon product research, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - walk me through one specific thing you do in it that most people skip or don't know about.

4. What's the biggest mistake you've seen (or made) in product development, and what did you change after? Be specific.

title: Operations & Knowledge-System Operator — AI-Native Infrastructure Business
description:
## About us, in plain terms



Blue Harbour (
)  helps large infrastructure organisations achieve **capital certainty** — a clear, governed, trustworthy view of where their capital programmes stand and the decisions behind them. We use AI to deliver that with a speed and diligence traditional consulting can't match: what used to take a consulting team weeks, we turn around fast and well. We're already live with our first major client in New Zealand, opening in Australia next, and built to expand into new markets after that.



AI is *how we work*, not what we sell. We sell certainty; AI is our edge in producing it.



We're hiring our **first operator** — the person who runs the commercial engine of the business so it keeps running and replicating into new markets.



## The role in one line



Run the commercial machine end-to-end — the product-and-knowledge engine that turns delivered work into reusable assets, the business-development pipeline, the executive backbone, and research — with the judgment to know what to handle and what to escalate.



## What you'll actually do



- **Run the product-and-knowledge engine — this is the heart of the role.** We turn every piece of delivered work into reusable, sellable product: the features, methods and analysis built for one client become the templates, modules and playbooks we deploy for the next. 



We run a structured, AI-operated "second brain" that several people contribute to, and it's already built. Your job is to keep it coherent *and* to drive the loop that converts one-off delivery into canonical, reusable assets — enforce the conventions, keep the canonical material clean and current, turn finished work into templates, and make the repeatable version of what we do one of our most valuable assets. You steward and systematise against the founder's "what good looks like"; you don't have to author the product judgment, you have to capture and compound it.



- **Run the growth pipeline — Australia next.** Research and qualify the organisations we'd work with as we open a new market — whether we partner to sell and deliver, or go direct — keep the CRM current, and draft the outreach and pitches. You run the funnel right up to the close; the founder holds the relationships and closes. As you go, you help capture *how* it's done — the repeatable version of "find and win the next market" is itself one of the assets we're building.

- **Hold the executive backbone.** Inbox, calendar, follow-up, focus protection. Nothing drops.

- **Build the pipeline of high-value rooms and relationships.** Research and organise the events, forums, and introductions that grow our network in target markets. You handle the research and logistics; the founder handles the relationships once he's in the room.

- **Run onboarding for new tea
mbers.** As we bring on technical and delivery people, you run the onboarding scaffolding — training flow, a guided path through the system, the day-to-day "where does this live" — so they get productive without the founder running it. (You're building the scaffolding a future delivery team will run.)

- **Draft offers of service** from a brief to ~70% off our template library; the founder takes them the rest of the way.

- **Run market and competitive research** — pricing, positioning, landscape, and which market to open next — delivered as a clear, decision-useful read with sources, not a pile of links.



You'll use AI throughout — the same way the business does, as the tool that makes the work fast and thorough. Day one, that means using AI with judgment to do real work; over time, you'll grow into genuinely running an AI-operated company, a skill that compounds and that almost no one has yet.



## What you get



- **USD 2,000–3,000/month**, depending on experience. This is a **full-time, single-client role**, and we pay a fair full-time rate specifically so you don't need a second client splitting your focus. The pay and the single-client commitment are two halves of the same deal.

- **Benefits from day one:** private health cover (HMO), a 13th-month equivalent, paid leave, and an equipment/internet allowance. We're hiring for the long term and we structure the role that way.

- **A provided AI tooling seat.**

- **Real growth without having to leave to get it.** You'll become fluent in running an AI-native operation — a rare and rising skill — and the role's scope deepens as the business opens new markets.

- **Stability.** This is a long-term seat at a growing business, not a project or a stop-gap. We're looking for someone who wants one solid, high-trust role for years, not the next rung.



## Ramp & hours



- Part-time for the first 6–8 weeks while you learn the system, **paid as a fixed monthly retainer** (not pro-rata), then full rate once you're up to speed — sooner if you're ready.

- Remote, with a **minimum 4 hours' daily overlap with New Zealand business hours** (Manila daytime — no night shifts). When in your day the rest of the work happens is flexible; the overlap and "nothing drops" are not.



## Who this is for



If you've run an operation end-to-end and been trusted with the whole picture before, you'll recognize this role. We're looking for someone who:



- leads with **judgment** — knows what to handle, what to escalate, and what to push back on;

- turns **one-offs into reusable assets** — instinctively makes the second version a template, not another from-scratch job, and can tell what's reusable from what's client-specific;

- thinks in **systems and conventions** — can keep a shared system coherent as more people use it, without bottlenecking everything through themselves;

- **finishes** — work arrives done and self-checked, not at 80%-and-back-to-you;

- writes **clearly and fast**, and can hold someone else's voice;

- uses **AI with judgment** — knows when to trust it, when not to, and when to do it by hand;

- is **discreet by instinct**, not just when told;

- wants a **long-term, single-client seat** and the security that comes with it.



This is a high-responsibility, high-ownership role. The right person is bracing for that — for owning outcomes and holding the line on what matters — not for anything else.

Here’s a concrete example. A member is flying to New York for three days. Their itinerary: check in to the Four Seasons, dinner at Nobu, a visit to the Met.

A good assistant books those things. You do something different.



You call the Four Seasons’ guest relations team, build a quick rapport, and arrange for two bottles of Dom Pérignon to be waiting in the room with a handwritten welcome card from the company.

Nobu is fully booked. You find the right contact, introduce yourself professionally, and get the table anyway - because you know how to talk to people who matter.

You reach out to the Met’s private tours team and arrange for a dedicated art historian to personally guide the member through the galleries, with refreshments waiting.



That’s the standard. Every member, every trip.

title: Executive & Personal Assistant to the CEO/Founder
description:
Location: Remote (occasional travel may be required)



High-growth Australian-based company helping service-based businesses scale through world-class sales support. 



Join Start-Up of the Year & Young Entrepreneur of the Year finalist, Cam, on his endeavours to spearhead global growth.



We’re searching for an Executive & Personal Assistant to the CEO who’s not afraid to work closely and get their hands dirty.



This is not for the shy. You will be required to travel 1-week in every 5-weeks and work in close quarters. 



You must be more than just organised - we want someone who becomes the trusted right hand, the safe sounding board, and the quiet force behind the scenes that keeps the CEO at the top of their game.



Why This Role Matters

This isn’t a calendar-and-coffee EA role. You’ll be the strategic partner… someone who can anticipate needs, solve problems before they escalate, and help drive the business forward.



In this role, you’ll develop a deep, professional working partnership with the CEO - what we call the “EA work-wife mentality.” That means building trust, understanding priorities, and becoming the go-to person for critical, confidential, and often time-sensitive matters. You’ll know when to offer support, when to challenge ideas, and when to protect their time and headspace.



You’ll Be Perfect For This Role If You…

 • Have proven EA or senior-level support experience.

 • Thrive in a high-trust, high-discretion working relationship.

 • Can manage confidential information with absolute integrity.

 • Are adaptable — equally happy booking a last-minute flight as you are reviewing a strategic plan.

 • Can work independently, often at a healthy distance from the broader team, without losing connection.

 • Love bringing order to chaos, and can keep your cool in fast-moving situations.

 • Have strong business acumen and understand the commercial impact of your work.

 • Possess a valid passport and are comfortable with occasional international travel whereas you'd be staying in close quarters with the CEO.



What Your Days Might Look Like

 • Acting as the gatekeeper for the CEO’s time, priorities, and focus.

 • Managing complex schedules, travel, and logistics across time zones.

 • Preparing briefs, reports, and follow-ups for meetings and projects.

 • Handling sensitive correspondence and acting as the CEO’s representative.

 • Stepping into operational or project-based tasks when urgent business needs arise.

 • Identifying process improvements and implementing smarter ways of working.





The Boundaries & Balance

We value a strong working partnership. You’ll be close to the CEO’s world, yet skilled at protecting both your time and theirs. You’ll know when to lean in for support and when to step back to maintain perspective



What We Offer

 • Competitive salary + performance incentives.

 • A role that is both strategic and hands-on.

 • The opportunity to work directly with the founder of a rapidly scaling company.

 • Flexibility to work remotely, with occasional travel for in-person collaboration.

 • A supportive environment where your contribution has visible impact.



If you’re the kind of person who thrives in a close, trusted working partnership — where your job is to make the CEO more effective every single day — we’d love to hear from you.

Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads.



Hit 12 = 10%

Hit 16 = 15%

Hit 20 = 20%

Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)
